Agents.title: Agents
Agents.incomplete_history: History is incomplete or unavailable. Counts cover only stored observations in the selected period.
Agents.partial_run: Some observations may be missing. This trace does not establish a complete conversation outcome.
Agents.usage_scope: Latest observed provider response; not a call total
Agents.event_limit: The view limit has been reached. Refresh to return to the first events.
Agents.generated_audio: Assistant text represents generated speech. Interrupted speech may not have been heard in full. Caller text is automated transcription.
Agents.delete_confirm: Delete this transcript permanently? Run metadata remains until its retention expires. Capture will not resume for this run.
Agents.handoff_scope: A committed handoff ends agent ownership. Its outcome does not describe the subsequent human conversation.
Agents.saved_pending: Settings saved. Synchronization is pending; the service will retry automatically.
Agents.retention_help: Settings apply to existing history too. Shorter retention can permanently remove expired data. Allowed range: 1–365 days.
Agents.capture_help: Capture is off by default. OpenAI Realtime is supported; Grok remains metadata only. Enabling caller transcription can add provider charges.
Agents.capture_internal: Enable transcripts for the Internal agent
Agents.capture_external: Enable transcripts for the External agent
Agents.capture_revocation: Enabling applies to new runs. Disabling stops active capture when synchronization completes; already stored text keeps its retention. Delete it from a run to remove it sooner.

error.not_found: This run is unavailable or its retention has expired.
error.conflict: Configuration changed. Reload this page before saving again.
error.invalid: Check the filter values or monitoring settings.
error.unavailable: Monitoring is unavailable. Refresh to retry. Call handling has its own service status.

Agents.enable_integrations: Enable connectors and new API runs
Agents.result_retention_help: API results are encrypted and retained for up to 24 hours. Run metadata follows the monitoring retention policy.
Agents.name: Name
Agents.public_voice: Allow public data lookup in voice calls (requires an agent grant and no customer identity field)
Agents.query_mapping: Query fields mapped to input fields (JSON)
Agents.body_mapping: Request fields mapped to input fields (JSON)
Agents.result_projection: Result fields mapped to response paths (JSON)
Agents.reconciliation_help: Check an uncertain operation using its configured read-only lookup. A check never repeats the write.
Agents.api_description: Scoped application tokens can start, read and cancel support-request runs. Each request needs a unique idempotency key.
Agents.integrations_disabled: Enable integrations in Connectors before starting a run.
Agents.token_once: Copy this token now. Its value is shown only once and is cleared when leaving this page.
Agents.confirm_ticket_test: Create a real ticket in the selected client’s configured service using the fields above.
Agents.request_identity: Request identity (reuse only for the same request)
Agents.application_saved: Changes saved. Publish drafts to use a new version.
Agents.reconcile_operation: Optional read operation for checking uncertain writes
Agents.reconcile_argument: Lookup input field receiving the operation ID
Agents.reconcile_result_field: Result field proving a matching record exists
Agents.operator_action_required: The outcome remains uncertain. Check the business service; this operation will not be repeated automatically.
Agents.operation_reconciled: The service confirmed the business record.
